hero.title: Ceritakan Rutinitas Harianmu
hero.text: Present simple untuk kebiasaan dan fakta (I, you, we, they), do/don't untuk tanya dan negatif, kata kerja sehari-hari, jam dan hari, serta preposition in/on/at.

cheatsheet.heading: Kapan memakai present simple?
cheatsheet.html: Untuk hal yang rutin, kebiasaan, atau fakta umum: I live in a flat. We go out a lot. Most British people live in houses. Bukan untuk yang sedang terjadi sekarang (itu present continuous: I'm eating).

cheatsheet.label: Interaktif 1 • Pola Present Simple
cheatsheet.title: I / You / We / They
rows: I live in Dubai. They speak Italian.
We don't have a big lunch. I don't work in an office.
Do you live in a flat? Do they go to school?
Yes, S do. / No, S don't.
Yes, I do. / No, we don't.
What time do you get up? Where do you work?

modes.label: Kata kerja
modes.title: V1 tanpa perubahan
modes.text: Untuk I/you/we/they, kata kerja tetap bentuk dasar. (Untuk he/she/it ditambah -s, dibahas di Module 4/P5.)

modes.label: do/don't
modes.title: don't = do not
modes.text: Setelah don't kata kerja tetap bentuk dasar: I don't like, bukan I don't likes.

modes.label: Pelafalan
modes.title: Do you = /djə/
modes.text: Diucapkan cepat dan lemah: “dyə live in a big city?”. Tekanan pada kata penting: LIVE, BIG CITY.

cheatsheet.label: Interaktif 2 • Kolokasi Kata Kerja
cheatsheet.title: Kata Kerja Umum + Pasangannya
rows: in a flat, in a big city, in London, with my parents, in a small town
for a big company, long hours, in an office
to English classes, out a lot, to the cinema a lot
at university, a lot, economics, law
fish, a lot of chocolate, in restaurants a lot, meat

modes.label: Jebakan go
modes.title: go to vs go out
modes.text: go to the cinema (ke tempat), tetapi go out (keluar/jalan-jalan) dan go home (tanpa to!).

options.label: past
options.title: Lewat (menit 1–30)
options.code: 6.05 = five past six • 8.15 = quarter past eight • 9.30 = half past nine

options.label: to
options.title: Kurang (menit 31–59)
options.code: 10.40 = twenty to eleven • 3.50 = ten to four • 9.55 = five to ten
options.text: Sisa menit + to + jam berikutnya. ⚠️ half past nine = 09.30, bukan “setengah sembilan”!

cheatsheet.label: Interaktif 4 • Preposition Waktu
cheatsheet.title: in / on / at
rows: at four o'clock, at night, at the weekend
on Sunday, on Sundays, on 14 November
in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening

modes.label: Kebiasaan
modes.title: on Sundays
modes.text: Hari + s = setiap hari itu: Most shops open on Sundays.

groups.title: Kegiatan
items: get up (early), go to bed (late), sleep
go to school/university/work, catch the bus
come home, watch TV, read the newspaper
have a bath / have a shower

groups.title: Mencari kesamaan
items: Really? I do. / Oh, I don't. (berbeda)

groups.title: Hari
items: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday

flashcards.a: S + V1: I live in a flat.
S + don't + V1: We don't have a big lunch.
Do + S + V1? Do you live in a big city? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Salah. Setelah don't selalu V1: I don't like coffee.
quarter past eight; quarter to nine.
in the morning/afternoon/evening, tetapi at night.
Me, too = setuju kalimat positif. Me, neither = setuju kalimat negatif.

flashcards.a: have breakfast/lunch/dinner, have a bath, have a shower, have a snack.
Ganda: office, wallet, business, dinner, married, bottle, address, normally, tissues, waitress. Tunggal: cousin, holiday, camera, parents.

ringkasan:
*RANGKUMAN P3 BAHASA INGGRIS: EVERYDAY LIFE*
1️⃣ Present simple = kebiasaan & fakta. I/you/we/they + V1.
2️⃣ (−) don't + V1 • (?) Do + S + V1? • Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
3️⃣ Kolokasi: live in/with, work for/long hours, go to/out/home, have breakfast/a shower.
4️⃣ Jam: five past six (6.05), quarter past eight, half past nine (9.30), twenty to eleven (10.40).
5️⃣ at four o'clock / at night / at the weekend • on Sunday(s) • in the morning.
6️⃣ Me, too (positif) • Me, neither (negatif).

materi.label: Bagian 1
materi.title: Isi Module 3
materi.html: Module 3 Everyday life membahas present simple (positif, negatif, pertanyaan, jawaban singkat) untuk I, you, we, they; kosakata kata kerja umum; bacaan Life in Britain; listening Life in Australia; real life: hari dan jam; rutinitas harian; dan tugas mencari kesamaan dengan teman.

materi.label: Bagian 2
materi.title: Present Simple: Bentuk dan Fungsi
materi.html:
Present simple menyatakan kebiasaan (I go to English classes on Tuesday), keadaan tetap (We live in a flat), dan fakta umum (Most shops open on Sunday).

  • (+) I/You/We/They live in a house.
  • (−) I/You/We/They don't have a big lunch.
  • (?) Do you speak English? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

Untuk pertanyaan dan negatif kita butuh do/don't karena kata kerja biasa tidak bisa dibalik seperti be. Bandingkan: Are you a student? (be) vs Do you study economics? (kata kerja biasa).

materi.label: ➕ Tambahan • be vs do
materi.title: Kapan Are you…? Kapan Do you…?

options.label: Ada kata kerja?
options.title: Tidak ada kata kerja → be
options.code: Are you married? Is she a doctor? Are they at home?
options.text: Kalau keterangannya kata sifat, pekerjaan, tempat, umur: pakai be.

options.label: Ada kata kerja
options.title: Kata kerja biasa → do
options.code: Do you work? Do they live here? Do you like pizza?
options.text: Kalau ada kata kerja (work, live, like, go): pakai do.

options.label: Kesalahan umum
options.title: Jangan dicampur
options.code: ❌ Are you like pizza?  ❌ Do you are a student?  ❌ I am not like coffee.
options.text: Benar: Do you like pizza? Are you a student? I don't like coffee.

materi.label: Bagian 3
materi.title: Life in Britain dan Life in Australia
materi.html:
Bacaan modul menggambarkan kehidupan di Inggris (ringkasan): kebanyakan orang tinggal di rumah, bukan flat; pekerja kantor go to work sekitar jam sembilan dan finish jam lima atau enam; mereka tidak pulang untuk makan siang, cukup a snack, dan makan besar di malam hari. Anak start school pukul sembilan dan selesai sekitar half past three. Toko open jam sembilan dan close sekitar jam enam, banyak yang buka hari Minggu, beberapa supermarket buka 24 jam.

Listening Life in Australia: Nicky bertanya tentang rumah, jam sekolah dan kerja, makan siang, jam buka toko, pub, dan kegiatan akhir pekan. Pertanyaannya memakai pola Do + S + V1 dan What time/When/What + do: Do most people live in flats or houses? What time do children go to school? When do shops open and close?

parts.label: o'clock
parts.title: Tepat
parts.text: It's four o'clock. ➕ Untuk jam 12 siang: midday/noon, 12 malam: midnight.

parts.label: past
parts.title: Setengah kanan
parts.text: Menit + past + jam sekarang: five past six (6.05), twenty-five past three (3.25).

parts.label: half past
parts.title: Setengah lewat
parts.text: 9.30 = half past nine. ⚠️ Bahasa Indonesia “setengah sepuluh”, bahasa Inggris “half past nine”. Jangan terjemahkan langsung!

parts.label: to
parts.title: Setengah kiri
parts.text: Sisa menit + to + jam berikutnya: ten to four (3.50), five to ten (9.55).

parts.label: Contoh
parts.text: Sisa 20 menit menuju 11 → twenty to eleven. Cara digital: ten forty.

modes.label: oh
modes.title: 05 = oh five
modes.text: Pada cara digital, menit 01–09 dibaca dengan oh.

materi.label: Bagian 4
materi.title: Daily Routines dan Find Things in Common
materi.html:
Kegiatan harian dari modul: sleep, get up early, go to bed late, have breakfast/lunch/dinner, read the newspaper, go to school/university, catch the bus, go to work, come home, watch TV, have a bath, have a shower.

Untuk mencari kesamaan: A: I'm a student. B: Me, too. • A: I'm not married. B: Me, neither. • A: I don't have breakfast. B: Really? I do. • A: I get up very early. B: Oh, I don't. Lalu laporkan: We both live with our parents. We don't get up early.

materi.heading: ➕ Adverb of frequency (pemanasan untuk P5)
materi.html: Untuk rutinitas kita sering menambah always, usually, often, sometimes, never sebelum kata kerja: I usually get up at six. I never go to bed early.
